Semantic mark/name baseline by Story/Episode/Scene and Hidden/Sentences/Tokens is `6/56/573`, `15/65/582`, and `102/152/669`. Codex Reading has 0 annotations/fragments; Codex Overview has 131 annotations and 648 placed fragments. Both lenses paginate to 2 pages / 46 lines with zero overflow; Overview layout reports 131 annotations and 648 fragments. Shared state is omniscient, no focus, Causal + Reference layers, no feature.

Future comparison should not demand raw-file checksum equality because the compiler revision is deliberately embedded in provenance and output. It should demand equality of source identity, semantic names/addresses, projection/placement classifications, hierarchy/navigation results, and non-provenance counts unless the provider delta declares a reviewed semantic change; only revision/provenance-derived bytes should move automatically.
